notes: Studio listened to every topic (the filter #, which never matches a topic under a $ root) for 3,000 ms after subscribing, in a window that ran 3,001 ms from when the connection was ready (Studio's window is 3,000 ms), and stopped because the window ended. It counted 3 messages on 3 distinct topics, 3 retained.

A topic not seen in the window may still exist: MQTT has no command that lists topics, so a subscriber sees a topic only when a message on it arrives in the window or the broker holds a retained message on it, and no answer is a complete count of the broker's topics or proof that a topic does not exist.

Studio listened to the one topic the request named for 3,000 ms after subscribing, in a window that ran 3,001 ms from when the connection was ready (Studio's window is 3,000 ms), and stopped because the window ended. It counted 1 message on that topic.
